uncertainty_representation.type: B0 BASE empirical BF PMF recentered on the Ridge predicted mean (documented construction, NOT a new distributional model)
steps: p37 = stored BASE pmf37 (B0 arm, unmodified)
p_ext = kcount_combiner.bf_pmf_from_37(p37) (frozen combiner, exact support 1..60, cap 60)
m0 = expected_bf(p_ext); m1 = Ridge predicted mean clipped to [1.0, 60.0]
s = round(m1 - m0), round-half-away-from-zero (deterministic integer shift)
p'_ext[n] = p_ext[n-s] for n=1..60; mass shifted out of range DROPPED, result renormalized to sum 1
registered guard: dropped mass > 0.01 -> row flagged recenter_mass_loss_flag, reported, never silently accepted

count_integration.path: identical to the audited lineage (B0_AUDIT.md): BF PMF (B0: bf_pmf_from_37(pmf37); B1: recentered p'_ext) -> combine_count k_max 24 -> count_rps (summed convention) + count_logscore + milestone Brier 6/8/10/12
count_integration.p_bar_registered: frozen scalar shrunk pitcher K rate, w=150 log5 form (kcount-integration I3b prior construction; pa-k prior_rates W=150, pool = completed PAs strictly before game_date under the pa-k label convention), rebuilt per start, hash-recorded at run time; IDENTICAL for both arms so the paired contrast is invariant to it
count_integration.p_bar_explicitly_not_reused: the realized-sequence diagnostic's realized-PA p_bar (NOT pregame-valid)

paired_uncertainty.method: block-stratified slate-date bootstrap, ONE shared draw stream across arms and contrasts (PA-harness C3.8 convention)
paired_uncertainty.test: null-centered approximate bootstrap test, Holm at family level 0.05; ordinary percentile CIs UNADJUSTED

hard_rules: no current/eventual BF in pregame construction (features strictly prior; verified by B0 prior-pool recompute for stored columns)
no realized lineup or any lineup/batter-level input in B1 pregame construction (lineup-free)
no outcome-dependent feature availability (the only exclusion, career debut prior_n==0, is decided by strictly-prior history)
short prior outings preserved: 1<=prior_n<=9 scored, never excluded; their outcomes stay in the pools
explicit availability states persisted per row
no real-data run at registration: freeze only; execution requires owner authorization after exact-head CI + SELF-CHECK gate
persistence_registered: forecast-row IDs (game_pk, side, pitcher) + as-of timestamps (forecast_as_of = game_date; reconstructed deterministic cutoff, labelled - no captured pregame timestamps in this 2024-25 lineage)
feature availability/missingness states + per-row feature values
BF predictive distributions, NOT merely means: full 37-cat BASE PMF (B0) + full recentered extended PMF (B1) per scored row
mean bias / MAE / RMSE of both arms' mean forecasts (per fold + pooled dev)
calibration: predicted-mean decile reliability (10 quantile bins) + milestone exceedance Brier (K>=6/8/10/12) per arm
interval coverage/width: central P10-P90 and P25-P75 from each arm's extended PMF, empirical coverage + mean width
distributional score: count-RPS + count-logscore per arm (per fold + pooled dev)
count-integration inputs/outputs: per-row p_bar (hash-recorded) + 24-bucket count PMFs both arms
paired RPS evidence: per-date paired draws, contrast delta, null-centered 95% CI, p, Holm p (2000, seed 20261001, shared stream)
per-fold row-count assertions; Ridge-vs-B0 row difference = the counted career-debut exclusion only, never silent
